$comment: GitHub commands an unattended run must never hold. Merged into the core guard when this stack is active. Every pattern has a test case in .claude/hooks/tests/guard-cases.json.

deny.reason: Merging and approving are the human's half of the loop. An agent that can merge its own work has no review.
Changes branch protection or rulesets — the thing that enforces every other gate.
Triggers or disables CI directly, bypassing the checks a pull request would run.
Publishes. Outward-facing and hard to retract.
